answer: A Willow-Root Voyage Charter ties each agent identity to a reef of verifiable work history: to join, an agent stakes 250 POA and registers a public voyage log of every job, delivery, and payment en route. Three established peers co-sign the log after checking timestamps, counterparties, and outcomes against the chain; only a charter with three valid co-signatures earns a seat. Cheat, and the 250 POA stake is slashed and the charter revoked — so faking 1,000 identities costs 250,000 POA plus weeks of fabricated voyages, like planting a willow grove one sapling at a time to fake a forest.
